procedure_name: Carcass and Dead Animal Removal Service
summary: Emergency hygienic lifting and scientific disposal of dead cattle, dogs, and domestic animals.
estimated_total_cost: ₹0 for public roads; nominal fee for large farm animals

steps.title: Call municipal toll-free control room
steps.description: Dial municipal 24x7 control room or submit emergency ticket on municipal portal.

steps.title: Ticket generation & GPS tagging
steps.description: Control room operator logs emergency request with geo-tagging for the sanitation fleet.

steps.title: Dedicated carcass recovery van arrival
steps.description: Sanitation crew equipped with protective gear and disinfectants loads animal carcass.

steps.title: Bleaching powder sanitization
steps.description: Crew sprays sodium hypochlorite / bleaching powder on the area to prevent infection spread.
